name: What Launched Today

sources.title: Homepage — daily launch board ('5,109+ launches'), upvotes, daily/weekly/monthly winners; 'Launch your startup' → /auth/signup?returnUrl=/dashboard/submit; footer Pricing link → /en#pricing

conditions: Launch submission goes through account signup → /dashboard/submit — the free/paid split wasn't visible on the rendered page (pricing section didn't render; 'Advertise — Get featured today' placements are clearly paid)
Standard launch listings appear free/self-serve; paid 'Advertise' spots (14 slots, '4/14 left') buy homepage featuring
requirements: An account (sign up at /auth/signup, redirected to /dashboard/submit)
A launched product: name, logo, tagline, description, website URL, tags/categories
Daily launch cycle — there's a countdown timer ('Time until next launch'); launches batch daily
preparation: Logo, tagline, and description (note: links inside listing descriptions render with rel=nofollow)
Website URL for the 'Visit website' button
Category + tag selection (AI, SEO, Productivity, Design, etc.)
workflow: Sign up at whatlaunched.today/auth/signup (return URL targets /dashboard/submit)
Complete the launch form in the dashboard
The launch enters the daily cycle; it appears under 'Just Launched'/All Launches and is eligible for Daily/Weekly/Monthly winner rankings by upvotes
Optional: buy an 'Advertise / Get featured' slot for homepage rotation
watchFor: Links embedded in the description are rel=nofollow — the SEO value hinges on whether 'Visit website' and profile links are followed (verify on a live page)
Small site; low upvote counts observed (single digits) — traffic expectations should be modest
Pricing page anchor exists but the section didn't render in the fetch — confirm free vs paid terms on the live form before assuming
countsAsLive: The launch has a public detail page on whatlaunched.today appearing in 'All Launches'/'Just Launched' with a working 'Visit website' link
unknowns: Whether submission is fully free or gated behind a plan (pricing section failed to render)
Whether the primary outbound link is dofollow
